channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from morningNewsSection1, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Lawyer champions second chances, now AI lends a hand
item.description: Millions of Americans with criminal records face employment hurdles. An AI-powered tool helps eligible individuals clear their records.

item.title: Over 4 million drop from SNAP as food aid changes take effect
item.description: SNAP participation has fallen steadily since last July. The decline coincides with major program reforms and historic challenges.

item.title: DOJ increasingly uses criminal conspiracy charges against ICE protesters
item.description: The Justice Department is applying federal conspiracy laws to ICE protesters. Some legal experts worry the approach may be overly broad.

item.title: A key Washington race offers Republicans a glimpse of their post-Trump future
item.description: The primary to replace Rep. Dan Newhouse gives Washington Republicans a rare chance at federal office. Candidates with different approaches are competing.
